title: San Antonio River Walk - Development Site

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is comprised of .681 acres. It is located in downtown San Antonio. The property fronts on E. Martin Street, St. Mary’s Street, E. Pecan Street, and finally, THE SAN ANTONIO RIVER!!!!

rows.label: Size
rows.text: .681 +/- Acres (includes a closed restaurant building that is approximately 4,851 sf per Bexar County Appraisal District)

rows.label: Paved Frontage
rows.text:
Includes entire city block
- 248 feet on E. Martin St.
- 169 feet on N. St. Mary’s St.
- 110 feet on Pecan St.

rows.label: River Frontage
rows.text: 209 feet on the San Antonio River

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility, and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The survey appears to indicate that there may be a very small amount of Floodplain present along the river.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property is level and buildable.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: Significant commercial development is surrounding the property.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: This property would suit a variety of commercial uses including hospitality and multifamily.

comments: The site is in the middle of the Central Business District; one block west of Travis Park, two blocks north of the Majestic Theatre, and 3 blocks west of the Tobin Center for the Performing Arts.
The site is one block away from the new apartment project “300 Main” that includes 354 class A apartments. Opening 2024.
Strategic location fronting #1 tourist attraction in Texas – The San Antonio River Walk

pages.annotations: ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey of Lots 1, 2 and 3, Block 13, New City Block 402, City of San Antonio, Bexar County (Vol. 6525, Pg. 2040 O.P.R.), Sinclair Land Surveying, Inc., dated February 8, 2023; 'AREA: 0.681 ACRES (29,683 SQUARE FEET)'; address 501 N. qa_notes: FRONTAGE vs SURVEY: Paved Frontage says '248 feet on E. Martin St.' but the survey (p7) dimensions the E. Martin St. line as N 89°55'04" E 258.66' (F). St. Mary's (169 vs 169.33') and Pecan (110 vs 110.00') agree. The river-side courses on the survey total about 226.44' (72.17 + 41.81 + 13.89 + 19.39 + 23.59 + 38.52 + 17.07) vs '209 feet on the San Antonio River'. Broker should confirm 248 and 209.
STALE COPY: comment says the '300 Main' apartments are 'Opening 2024.' - already past as of the Oct 2025 demographics. Transcribed as printed.

VARIANT: classified 'land' because the package markets a 'Development Site' (Prismic category Land), but the Size row says it includes a closed restaurant building of approximately 4,851 sf (survey shows a one-story brick building on Lot 1).
TRANSACTION: the PDF never says 'For Sale'/'For Lease'; set to 'For Sale' (Investment: Contact Broker). Prismic transaction_type is null.

TITLE: cover reads 'RARE OPPORTUNITY!' (red) / 'SAN ANTONIO RIVER WALK - DEVELOPMENT SITE' / 'SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS' - no street address on the cover. Used eyebrow 'Rare Opportunity!' and title 'San Antonio River Walk - Development Site'. Prismic title is 'St. Mary's St. at E. Martin St. — River Walk'; demographic page reads 'RIVERWALK – N. ST. MARY’S ST. AT E. MARTIN ST.'; survey address is 501 N. St. Marys St.
ZONING: PDF 'Downtown District, San Antonio'; Prismic 'Downtown District, City of San Antonio' (same district, different wording).
SIZE: '.681 +/- Acres' (leading zero omitted as printed); survey 0.681 acres (29,683 sq ft); Prismic 0.681 acres (match). No acreage line on the cover.
PRICE: 'Contact Broker' in PDF and Prismic (match).

Prismic highlights paraphrase the PDF comments: 'three blocks west' (PDF '3 blocks west'), 'one block from' (PDF 'one block away from'), 'Opening 2024' without period, 'fronting the #1 ... — The San Antonio River Walk' (PDF 'fronting #1 ... – The San Antonio River Walk').

Frontage street names are inconsistent in the original ('E. Pecan Street' in Location vs 'Pecan St.' in Paved Frontage; 'St. Mary’s Street' vs 'N. St. Mary’s St.'). Location ends 'THE SAN ANTONIO RIVER!!!!' in caps with four exclamation marks. Kept as printed.

DISCLOSURE PAGE (p9) is an older version: it names 'Roalson Interests, Inc.' and the old address 'BUILDING 2, SUITE 206, 2338 NORTH LOOP 1604 W., SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS 78248', whereas the other packages use 17721 Rogers Ranch Pkwy., Suite 125, San Antonio, Texas 78258.
PDF link defect: the bwilson email hyperlink target is 'mailto:bwilson@roalson.com%20/' (trailing ' /' captured in the link); the printed text is correct.
Spec demographics table matches the Demographic Overview; Owner+Renter sums equal Households 2025 Estimate in all columns.
